title: Coastal States Bank Announces Tonya Mazurek as Vice President, SBA Business Development Officer
summary: Coastal States Bank (“CSB”) has announced the addition of Tonya Mazurek to its Government Guaranteed Lending (“GGL”) team as Vice President, SBA Business Development Officer, further expanding its national GGL division into Colorado
body_markdown:
**DENVER, COLORADO** – Coastal States Bank (“CSB”) has announced the addition of Tonya Mazurek to its Government Guaranteed Lending (“GGL”) team as Vice President, SBA Business Development Officer, further expanding its national GGL division into Colorado.


With more than 15 years of commercial banking and government guaranteed lending experience, Mazurek has helped business owners navigate complex financing opportunities with her expertise in SBA lending, loan structuring and the interpretation of SBA Standard Operating Procedures.
In her role at CSB, she will serve small business owners with 7(a) and 504 SBA loans and USDA loans to support acquisitions, partner buyouts, owner-occupied commercial real estate and more.


“Tonya’s passion for relationship building and her technical expertise reflect the values that continue to distinguish Coastal States Bank,” said Rose Fletcher, CSB’s GGL Sales Manager. “We look forward to having her join our team as she serves our clients through integrity, responsiveness and partnership.”


Mazurek has been recognized as Colorado SBA Small Lender of the Year. She also co-hosts SBA Today, an SBA news podcast, where she educates industry professionals on evolving SBA policies, trends, and best practices. Her expertise has also been recognized nationally through interviews and features in The New York Times and The Wall Street Journal.


**About Coastal States Bank**


Coastal States Bank builds relationships by providing a full range of banking services designed for businesses, their owners and individuals looking for a local banking partner. CSB has a community banking presence in the Lowcountry of South Carolina (Hilton Head Island, Bluffton, Beaufort and Charleston), Savannah and the Atlanta Metropolitan market, and serves communities across the country through its Government Guaranteed Lending, Senior Housing, Correspondent Marine and Mortgage Banker Finance lines of business. At present, CSB has approximately $2.4 billion in total assets.


CSB is a wholly-owned subsidiary of CoastalSouth Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: COSO).
